mapper.insert: INSERT INTO boardFile ( boardIdx, originalName, storedName, fileSize, contentType ) VALUES ( #{boardIdx}, #{originalName}, #{storedName}, #{fileSize}, #{contentType} )
mapper.select: SELECT fileIdx, boardIdx, originalName, storedName, fileSize, contentType, createdAt FROM boardFile WHERE boardIdx = #{boardIdx} ORDER BY fileIdx ASC
SELECT fileIdx, boardIdx, originalName, storedName, fileSize, contentType, createdAt FROM boardFile WHERE fileIdx = #{fileIdx} AND boardIdx = #{boardIdx}
